sentences.l2: 以后，机器人可以做很多工作。
sentences.l1: In the future, robots can do many jobs.
Some people will have no jobs.
The government should help these people.
Money should also be divided fairly.
Everyone should think of solutions together.

sentences.l2: 世界在变，我们要准备好。
sentences.l1: The world is changing, and we should be ready.
